multiple LXD clusters and projects. Works with Incus too.

Create a VM/LXC and you can run your playbooks.

## Homelab

My own selfhosted private _micro_ Cloud, based on four Dell OptiPlex 7010 Micro nodes. Running **LXD** together with **Ceph**, **ZFS** and **OVN**. 
192GiB memory gives plenty of room for breaking things on purpose. Everything infra-as-code.

## Homeprod
Alongside my lab, a custom-built 10" NAS running Ubuntu 26.04 virtualizes my home production with LXD and OVN: Home Assistant OS, a central reverse proxy, Authentik for SSO, OpenBao for secrets, AdGuard, Jellyfin, WireGuard, self-hosted GitHub Actions runners, Discord bots, and a few game servers.
